mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt ( r_u, r_place, r_price, r_date, r_goods, category, gender ) VALUES ( #{r_u}, #{r_place}, #{r_price}, #{r_date}, #{r_goods}, #{category}, #{gender} )
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt WHERE r_u = #{uId} GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ORDER BY dt

SELECT YEARWEEK(r_date, 1) AS yearWeek, MIN(DATE(r_date)) AS weekStart, MAX(DATE(r_date)) AS weekEnd, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt WHERE r_u = #{uId} GROUP BY YEARWEEK(r_date, 1) ORDER BY yearWeek
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt WHERE r_u = #{uId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
SELECT gender AS gender, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt WHERE gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(daily_sum), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS daily_sum FROM receipt WHERE r_u = #{uId} GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(daily_sum), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS daily_sum FROM receipt GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
